headline: Better Than Leon
caption:
Belal Muhammad just took another shot at Leon Edwards, and this one got personal.
Belal or Leon? 👇

On X, the former UFC welterweight champ claimed his wrestling, his cornering and even his bald patch are better than Leon's. Both men are on three-fight skids with no fight booked, so a trilogy suddenly makes sense.

Run it back a third time?
question: Belal or Leon?

v2.story: Belal says his wrestling, his cornering and even his bald patch beat Leon's.
